label: pass
notes: Synthetic PASS: two voices with different rhythm/tactic; radio motif; want/obstacle/cost.
text:
INT. DISPATCH BOOTH - NIGHT

A cracked RADIO hisses between frequencies. MARA thumbs the dial like it owes her money. JONAS watches the door.

MARA
You take the north stair. I keep the radio.

JONAS
And if the guard turns early?

MARA
Then you become the static. Not me.

Jonas slides his KEYCARD across the desk. Mara does not pick it up.

JONAS
That card opens my locker. Not the archive.

MARA
Good. I need something that costs you.

She pockets the radio. The red light blinks once, then holds.
